domain: P2 — Extracción semántica de ajustes Scentra a CBN
evidence_scope: Consulta del grafo existente y lectura de fuentes públicas. No se leyeron .env, .local, secretos ni datos; no se importó la app, consultó SQL, ejecutó Docker o proveedor. Scentra y C13 permanecen intactos. Este borrador no acredita implementación, paridad completa ni cierre P2.

inventory.authorization: Tenant update: owner/admin. Own profile: authenticated user; changed email requires current password. role_label is descriptive and must not grant roles.
inventory.p2_requirement: Persist a single educational institution and own profile with validation, current authorization, audit and optimistic revision. Keep access user, SIIE employee and AI agent distinct. Exclude tenant marketplace/trial creation and plan display.
inventory.baseline_gap: The ordinary CBN Settings view shows Identidad pendiente; this observation precedes the new P2 implementation.

inventory.p2_requirement: Configuration and encrypted local persistence belong to P2. Never return raw stored secrets, copy ciphertext without its verified owner/key, or expose .env. Preserve technical provider quotas/budget limits independently of institutional module availability.

inventory.authorization: Source integration writes owner/admin; diagnostics/phone listing owner/admin/supervisor. C12/C13 tickets are isolated local access, not accounts/roles/session authorization.

target_existing_persistence: C12 crm_channels2 application/integration schema with institution, UUID and revision

inventory.authorization: Source mutations/process require owner/admin. CBN must distinguish configuration permission, secret rotation and receipt/replay operation; listing events must not expose secret/body data.
inventory.p2_requirement: Persist endpoint settings and permissions without opening a listener or treating active=true as accepted public operation. Audit sanitized rotations/configuration; never persist verification plaintext in the settings document.
out_of_scope: event normalization/replay and delivery workers; P4

inventory.authorization: Source team mutation checks TEAM_ADMIN_ROLES; only owner may assign owner, and self-deactivation is rejected. CBN needs explicit action permissions rather than decorative role labels or a client-only menu guard.
inventory.p2_requirement: Implement current server-side account/session/role checks so logout, revocation, disable and role removal apply to direct requests immediately. Verify missing permission returns a denial and sanitized failure audit. Do not derive authentication from an SIIE employee or AI agent record.
inventory.source_caveat: get_current_user validates access JWT claims without looking up current account/session/role; logout revokes refresh session. These source mechanisms alone do not prove immediate access-token revocation required by the CBN P2 closure.
inventory.source_second_factor_contract: TOTP SHA1, six digits, 30-second period, window +/-1. Password-confirmed setup stores an encrypted secret; verification activates TOTP and returns eight recovery codes once, stored as hashes. Login challenge accepts TOTP or a remaining recovery code with expiry/attempt controls. email_otp is a real source option requiring configured SMTP outside local mode; disabling selects none. No SMS option was found. CBN can preserve the email option as explicitly unavailable until provider acceptance, without sending or inventing email delivery.
out_of_scope: external OAuth identity or email/SMS delivery without separate provider acceptance
customer deletion/export operation from Security tab belongs to its own business/privacy scope
